short_summary: Manual first test run. Found 12 candidate stories; 4 passed two-source verification and check-news (summer water restrictions/dam levels, school-holiday pool hours, Tutu Memorial Park construction, City scam warning); 8 discarded (no independent second source: Jakes Gerwel Drive reopening, Govan Mbeki Road MyCiTi works, Heritage Day office closures, Nyanga rank upgrade, Castle of Good Hope programme; conflicting dates: Stormers URC fixtures; older than 10 days: Stormers record-crowd story, SANRAL N1 wind closures).
